role: Preregistered acceptance rules before generating prospective CFD loads

scope.not_target: controller tracking error or motor-command torque
scope.steady_validated_input_scope: fixed arm pose, body-relative translation, angular velocity and joint rates zero
scope.dynamic_scope: q0 locked arm, small-amplitude laminar whole-domain oscillation; independent joint motion and a full 9x9 added-mass matrix not identified

baselines.deployment_reference_scope: first 6 outputs are total-body loads, not pure hull; do not subtract held-out base0 truth to manufacture hull predictions
baselines.matched_component_baseline: candidate A trained on exactly the same training rows and folds as candidates B/C

development.data_role: all previously viewed q0/qb/qc/qd cases are retrospective development data
development.sensitivity: include/exclude the 3 explicitly capped tail-mean rows, without relabelling them converged
development.grouping: whole pose and direction family; opposite directions and multiple speeds of the same axis grouped; no within-case time splitting
development.scaling_and_model_selection: training-fold labels only; regularization and feature selection inside the training fold
development.unidentifiable_fold: flag unsupported/unidentifiable parameters and report coverage; do not silently set them to zero and count as an ordinary predictive failure
development.repeat_cycle_check: cycle2 -> cycle3 is a repeatability check, not independent-case generalization

metrics.units: force N; moment and torque N*m
metrics.floor_note: scoring denominator floors, NOT experimental accuracy or noise claims
metrics.case_weighting: equal whole-case contribution; physical time samples remain grouped
metrics.harmonics: measured and predicted DC/fundamental/second harmonic projected on the same actual motion law; actual N/Nm amplitudes, not unit-excitation pseudoloads

physical_checks.zero_input_load: zero under zero relative velocity and acceleration
physical_checks.dynamic_mass: effective total 6x6 mass symmetric PSD in the observed locked-arm subspace, with dimensional scaling recorded
physical_checks.dissipation: check declared candidate dissipation/zero-work properties; do not claim independent sub-body passivity or reciprocity is universally required in an interacting fluid
physical_checks.geometry: force points/directions fixed from geometry or virtual geometry assumptions before held-out evaluation

acceptance.per_channel_allowed_regression: max(5% of matched-baseline RMSE, prespecified estimate of CFD tail/cycle variability)
acceptance.component_uncertainty_note: tail SD is not an independent measurement uncertainty; show raw absolute values and sensitivity
acceptance.if_quality_or_target_fails: report partial/inconclusive/not-improved; do not replace the default theta or claim full nine-channel validation

prospective_validation.freeze_before_cfd: hash model files, parameter tables, protocol, case config, inference code and prior predictions in blind_protocol.json
prospective_validation.case_budget: 18 cores, one Fluent solve at a time; at most 2500 steady iterations or 240 oscillation steps; automatic retries disabled
prospective_validation.retry_budget: at most one explicit numerical/geometry repair retry with recorded reason, never by deleting original artifacts
prospective_validation.final_artifacts: save starting case and matching end-state case/data; no blanket restart claim without read-back check
